part: C4 INTENT INTEGRATOR (c4/intent-int): merged planned-command intent sharing (obs + head + coopfix), E2E CPU gate, COOPFIX-gate intent extension
head_commit: 3e7933f2 merge c4/coopfix-int e2e: synthetic bank -> statistical filter + v2v pairs + own_pass -> gate PASS; options-off byte-identity
design: each CAV policy carries an INTENT HEAD: H=5 planned absolute-acceleration commands (1 s steps, action units/clip) broadcast at step t and observed by the K=4 nearest CAV partners at t+1 (one-step V2V latency, no simultaneous dependency) plus an intent_valid mask; executed action is UNCHANGED (existing action head); head trained for ALL arms identically by supervised loss to the agent's OWN realised next-H commands (masked at episode end/despawn); B/R bank pairs additionally carry the winning plan's future commands as intent targets (MAPPO-PIS-style, arXiv 2408.06656, but learned)

merged.c4/intent-obs: a8fda5c5 (INTENT_OBS_READY.json merged): v2v_obs.py V2V_INTENT_DIM=48=K*(6+H+1), K=4, H=5, V2VConfig(v2v_intent, v2v_intent_horizon), V2VIntentBuffer/publish_intents (t-1 freshness gate, reset/despawn), v2v_intent_features/slot_block, v2v_live.intent_binding_gate, v2v_runner.prepare(v2v_intent=), v2v_runtime controller intent mode + Policy(v2v_dim); test_v2v_intent_obs_cpu.py 12 passed

keys.v2v: bool, true for the intent arms
keys.v2v_intent: bool, DEFAULT OFF; requires v2v_dim==48 (enforced by v2v_runner.prepare and v2v_live.intent_binding_gate)
keys.accel_bounds: the binding's own action clip [-3., 2.6] is the intent clip (never hand-set)

option.off_contract: flag off: every code path skipped; observations byte-identical (v2v_intent_features returns EXACTLY v2v_features), loader byte-identical to accel_learner.load, update metric schema unchanged (no intent keys), bank pairs carry no intent_target, gate report/verdict checks are exactly the pre-intent four - all asserted by tests

A-v2v.paths: accel_runner.run: update(policy, opts, eps, rng, intent=intent_config(b)) - PPO + supervised intent loss; no bank options

B-v2v.paths: warm_runner.run_arm: A update(intent=cfg); B/R exact_update(intent=cfg, imitation_epochs, imitation_trust, cooperative) + bank pairs carrying context['v2v'] and context['intent_target']

arm_config.R-v2v: identical to B-v2v (same keys; R fairness max_decisions unchanged)

covers: MAPPO-u0-shaped checkpoint loads through v2v_model.load_checkpoint with the intent binding keys: zero-init 48-column input extension + zero-init intent head; executed actions byte-identical (<=1e-7) to the non-v2v load; plain load state-dict-equal to the registered loader (all options off)

3 synthetic CAVs over several steps: planned commands published at t (publish_intents), observed by partners at t+1 with intent_valid=1 and byte-exact payload; stale at t+2 (zeros + mask 0); option-off block EXACTLY the plain v2v block

ONE full-pass imitation update on a synthetic cooperative bank (bank_imitation.run_separate, intent=) lowers BOTH the action imitation error (L1, report['action_error_after_mps2'] < before) and the masked intent error (report['intent']['error_after_mps2'] < before), with gradient flowing through the v2v channels and the intent head
options off = byte-identical behaviour: accel_learner.update() == update(intent=None) (metrics and post-update weights equal, no intent keys)

gate.extension: option v2v_intent (DEFAULT OFF): loads through the intent binding (intent head attached exactly as the live runner), trains the head on the pairs' plan-future targets during the offline phase with the registered weight, and the report adds report['intent'] = {enabled, horizon, weight, error_before_mps2, error_after_mps2 (bank_imitation.intent_error, masked mean absolute plan-future command error m/s^2 on the COOPERATIVE pairs), pairs_with_intent_targets, runner_report} and report['v2v_weights']['partner_intent'] = {columns (K*H=20), horizon, heads{actor,critic:{nonzero,l2,max_abs}}, moved, rule} - the PARTNER-INTENT input columns (per-partner intent_0..intent_4 inside the K*(6+H+1) block, plain six features and mask channel excluded)
gate.verdict: PASS iff the four pre-intent checks hold, plus intent_error_falls (after < before) and partner_intent_weights_moved when v2v_intent is on; option off keeps the pre-intent verdict semantics byte-identical
gate.cli: python -m tools.coopmwm.coopfix_gate run --checkpoint CKPT (--pairs-file P.json | --bank-root ROOT --arm B --training-seed N) [--v2v --v2v-dim 48 --v2v-intent --v2v-intent-horizon 5 --bank-filter --imitation-trust --passes 5 --coefficient 1.0 --out COOPFIX_GATE_REPORT.json]; 'status' lists option READY state

gate_tests.covers: intent_columns/partner_intent weight report shapes (None on plain 24-wide, 20 columns on 48-wide, zero at load); option-off report has no intent keys and exactly the four pre-intent checks; option-on phase lowers intent error and moves the partner-intent columns (verdict PASS); planned_commands reads the zero-init head
